preview: Barbados Tridents face Guyana Amazon Warriors in CPL 2026 Match 35 at Kensington Oval. The match is scheduled for Sun 13 Sep at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: Barbados return to the Tridents identity and national colours in 2026, with Gudakesh Motie, Sherfane Rutherford and Brandon King among the senior Caribbean core. Guyana retain Shimron Hetmyer, Romario Shepherd, Shai Hope and Shamar Joseph, while 10 of their 12 locally selected players come from Guyana. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
